apiMessages.content: Plan my climbing training for this week.

content.text:
Plan: 2 climbing days spaced for recovery, 1 hangboard-focused day, 1 antagonist/core day. Rest Wed/Fri/Sun.

Tue already set (Bouldering). Adding Thu, Sat, Sun.

apiMessages.content: Caught a problem: Sat [evt-ai-2] and Sun [evt-ai-1] already existed. I duplicated both. Deleting my copies.

I don't have the IDs for the duplicates I just created — the create calls didn't return them. Refresh the schedule and send me the current list; I'll delete the two extras ([evt-ai-1]/[evt-ai-2] are the originals to keep).

Once cleaned up, the week stands:
- **Tue** — Bouldering (power) [fix-1]
- **Sat** — Lead Endurance + ARC [evt-ai-2]
- **Sun** — Antagonist + Core [evt-ai-1]

Missing a **Thu hangboard + limit** day. Want me to add it? Rest Wed/Fri.
Update: I tweaked a finger pulley at yesterday's session — sharp pain when crimping. Replan the rest of the week around that.

content.text:
Finger pulley tweak with sharp pain = stop climbing now. No crimping, no hangboarding, no hanging. Full finger rest ~5–7 days, then reassess. Get it looked at if pain persists or there was a pop/swelling.

Replanning: kill both climbing days, keep finger-safe training (legs, antagonist, core, cardio). Sun's Antagonist + Core already loads fingers zero — keep as is.

Converting Tue to a legs + core session, cancelling Sat lead.

changes.title: Legs + Core (finger rest)
changes.description: No finger load. Maintain lower-body strength and core tension while the pulley settles. Nothing that requires gripping/crimping.

apiMessages.content: Now cancelling Sat lead session — no lead climbing on a tweaked pulley.
